note: Daily current-affairs quizzes. The app derives each day's URL from the date and links out — it does not copy the questions in. They are the publisher's editorial product, and the same reasoning that keeps toppers' booklets on their own sites applies here. `url` is expanded at runtime with {yyyy} {mm} {dd} {d} {month}: {dd} is zero-padded, {d} is not, {month} is the lowercase full month name.

sources.name: InsightsOnIndia
sources.note: Five questions, published most mornings. Nothing on Sundays, and the day's set can go up late — if the link misses, the index has it.
